body:
Delhi NCR's smog, so far (times in IST, oldest first):

2 Nov, 07:00 IST: Air quality across Delhi NCR falls to 'severe' as readings pass 450. [1]
2 Nov, 11:35 IST: Schools across Delhi NCR move classes online until Friday. (Corrected on 3 Nov: only Delhi's primary schools moved online.) [2, 3]
2 Nov, 15:10 IST: Building work stops and diesel trucks are kept out of Delhi under the emergency rules; offices are asked to let staff work from home where they can. [4]
3 Nov, 09:20 IST: CORRECTION of the 2 Nov, 11:35 IST update: only Delhi's primary schools moved online; schools in Noida and Gurugram stay open. [5]

Not confirmed: how long Delhi's primary schools stay online. The 2 Nov update said until Friday; the correction doesn't repeat it.
